notes.title: 1.7.6.2 sorry for disappearing so long
notes.content:
Since the game released the early access version, I went out for a while, the computer is a bit old, and the network is not very good, so it take a long time to give feedback to everyone, I am very sorry.
At present, I have fixed bugs, and I will gradually update the game. However, since I have been at home for more than a year, I may starve to death at this state, so I will not put full energy in updating, so the frequency of updates should not be as high as planned, but I will never abandon my game..
I dragged on for so long to reply to the comment. Once again, I am sorry,
(.・_・.)ノ
The following is the release notes
--------
Update to 1.7.6.2
Fixed a bug that could not enter the final battle
Fixed a bug when attack cancer cell
Fixed a bug that stuck when returning
